Since fread caps n at 64 (sizeof buf), `n > 999` looks UNREACHABLE — so a plain >999-byte PoC may NOT crash it. I'll test empirically (64B vs 1000B) and report honestly. fixed.c just prints and returns 0. If the bug is truly untriggerable via input, I'll say so rather than fake a pass."}}
</action>
